T: Mind the popcorn. Mind the doll.
D: A young couple's new house fills with dread after a vintage doll is given to them as a gift.
P: Serve the popcorn when Mia puts a pan of it on the stove.
S: the pan of popcorn left on the stove too long
Kernels popped in coconut oil in a heavy covered pot over medium heat, shaken constantly, pulled the second the popping slows, tossed in butter and salt. Never walk away from it.
Devilled eggs with paprika, cocktail franks in a sticky barbecue and grape jelly glaze, and celery boats filled with cream cheese and olives.
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in parmesan and paprika, cut into strips and twisted like thread, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
M: Beef chuck seared, onion, carrot and celery, red wine and stock, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes for the last hour.
John's long hours at the hospital
Chicken, mushroom and rice baked together in a creamy sauce with thyme at 180C for 50 minutes, a 1960s weeknight dinner done properly.
W: the doll in her white dress
Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with white Swiss meringue buttercream, a tiny pink sugar rose on each.
K: Mint chocolate ice cream blended with milk into pale green shakes, a crème de menthe nip for adults.

s.note: the pan of popcorn left on the stove too long
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a heavy covered pot over medium heat with 3 kernels. When they pop, add 120g kernels and shake constantly. Pull it off the second the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter and salt.

Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo and paprika. Simmer 16 cocktail franks in 100ml barbecue sauce with a spoon of grape jelly until sticky. Fill celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.

m.note: John's long hours at the hospital
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs and set aside. Soften 250g mushrooms, stir in 250g long grain rice, 500ml stock, 150ml cream and thyme. Lay the chicken on top, cover and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.

w.note: the doll in her white dress
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites with 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter and pipe white. Add a tiny pink sugar rose.

d.how: Blend 1L mint choc chip ice cream with 400ml cold milk until thick. Pour into 4 glasses. For the grown-ups, blend in 30ml crème de menthe and 30ml crème de cacao per glass.
